framework_library.A: Mouse Trap (IT/CTO/SAP audience) — 45-55 word body. Anchor: SAP Oct 2025 Blueprints guidance treats single-tenant as suitable only for simpler scenarios. CTA: reply.
framework_library.B: Finance Angle (CFO/Finance audience) — 45-55 word body. Anchor: most Integration Suite incidents hit Finance via audit findings + outage cost; SAP guidance treats single-tenant as not suitable for complex estates. CTA: reply.

rules: First touch only. Single follow-up max (+5 business days) if no reply.
PDF advisory NOT attached on first touch — offered on reply.
Subject 4-7 words, sentence case, includes company name.
Body 45-55 words. Casual + unsure tone. No competitor names. No 'I hope this email finds you well'.
No booking link. CTA is a one-line reply.
Anchor phrasing softened to match SAP's actual source wording.
